claims.claim_quote: به همین دلیل، در دندانی که پالپیت برگشت‌پذیر دارد، توصیه می‌شود خط ترک را با احتیاط برداریم و در نهایت حفره را با یک رستوریشن باندشونده مهروموم و سیل کنیم [2].
claims.source_quote: If pulp status is reversible pulpitis, remove the old restoration and crack line carefully because cracks are always colonized by bacterial biofilms.
claims.note: inference after «به همین دلیل», judged on its conclusion (F1). The source advises both actions in its own voice (F2-iii way 1). Careful removal of the crack line in reversible pulpitis is in the quoted sentence. Filling with a bonded restoration is in the next sentence: «Fill the cavity with bonded direct or indirect restoration.» Both halves match at the same strength.

claims.claim_quote: یکی از توصیه‌ها این است که اگر درد هنگام جویدن ادامه پیدا کرد، دندان با روکش موقت محافظت شود و سپس نیاز به درمان ریشه دوباره ارزیابی شود [2].
claims.source_quote: If biting pain persists, then make a provisional crown and reevaluate the necessity of root canal treatment.
claims.note: the source gives the action as its own advice (F2-iii way 1), with the same condition (persisting biting pain), the same order (provisional crown, then reevaluate root canal treatment) and the same strength.

claims.claim_quote: اما اگر درد باقی بماند یا علائم پالپیت ظاهر شود، باید وضعیت پالپ دوباره بررسی و در صورت لزوم درمان ریشه انجام شود.
claims.source_quote: If biting pain persists, then make a provisional crown and reevaluate the necessity of root canal treatment.
claims.note: the pulpitis-symptoms trigger agrees with 'If pulp status is irreversible pulpitis or necrotic, perform root canal treatment initially and make a provisional crown.'

claims.claim_quote: در موارد پالپیت برگشت‌ناپذیر یا نکروز پالپ، ابتدا درمان ریشه انجام می‌شود و پس از آن، دندان با روکش موقت محافظت می‌شود تا با برطرف شدن علائم، روکش دائم ساخته شود [2].
claims.source_quote: If pulp status is irreversible pulpitis or necrotic, perform root canal treatment initially and make a provisional crown.
claims.note: final-crown half matches 'If symptom disappears, then make a final crown.'

claims.claim_quote: اگر ترک به زیر لثه گسترش پیدا کرده و با پاکت پریودنتال عمیق همراه باشد، پیش‌آگهی دندان نامطلوب است؛ چه پالپ وایتال باشد و چه دندان قبلاً درمان ریشه شده باشد.
claims.source_quote: If a crack extends subgingivally and deep periodontal pocket is associated with the crack, explain the poor prognosis to the patient and decide whether to treat or extract the cracked tooth.
claims.note: the source states the poor prognosis with no pulp-status condition, so naming both pulp states narrows nothing and widens nothing

claims.claim_quote: بهتر است این موضوع را پیش از ادامه‌ی درمان با بیمار در میان بگذاریم [2].
claims.source_quote: If a crack extends subgingivally and deep periodontal pocket is associated with the crack, explain the poor prognosis to the patient and decide whether to treat or extract the cracked tooth.
claims.note: pointing word 'این موضوع' read through to the poor prognosis in u62

claims.claim_quote: باکتری‌ها نیز از طریق توبول‌های عاجی امکان نفوذ به سمت پالپ را دارند [3].

Only the vital

claims.claim_quote: در این مطالعه، ترک را فقط تا ۲ میلی‌متر داخل عاج تراشیدند و جلوتر نرفتند.

If the crack line was
further deeper than 2mm in dentin, then no attempt was

claims.source_quote:
Group C was further sub-divided into two

claims.claim_quote: این دندان‌ها هم با کامپوزیت ترمیم شدند و بعد از یک سال، نتیجه‌شان تفاوت معنی‌داری با دندان‌هایی که در همان عمق ۲ میلی‌متری خط ترکی در کف حفره‌شان دیده نمی‌شد، نداشت [4].

However, there was no significant

of depth 2mm into dentin.

The composite-restoration half is also stated: «All the teeth were restored with light cure posterior composite resin restorative material.» The one-year period matches the 12-month recall in the study.

claims.claim_quote: تعداد این دندان‌ها خیلی کم بود و شکست درمان هم به عمق ترک بستگی داشت [4].
claims.source_quote:
There was
significant difference between the depth of the crack
(p=0.033) and failure.

claims.note: opinion marker: از نگاه ما

fidelity.source_conclusion: Posterior incomplete cracked teeth without caries or previous restoration and with a mesio-distal orientation, if is either asymptomatic or have signs and symptoms of reversible pulpitis, can be managed successfully in about 91.2% cases with direct composite resin restorative material for at least a period of 12 months.

claims.claim_quote: از طرف دیگر، یک مطالعه‌ی آزمایشگاهی در سال ۲۰۲۲ نشان داد که استفاده از فرز برای برداشتن ترک کف حفره می‌تواند ترک‌های ریز جدیدی ایجاد کند یا باعث گسترش ترک قبلی شود [5].
claims.source_quote: Dental burs used with the purpose of removing pulpal floor dentin cracks induced new small cracks and extended existing cracks, and the volume of removed dentin depended on the shape and size of the bur.
claims.note: «می‌تواند» after «نشان داد که» reports a capability the study observed (the sense of English 'can', F2-ii), not a 'may' hedge. The year 2022 is not stated in the abstract; it is a modifier, not a separate assertion.

claims.claim_quote: ترک‌های بررسی‌شده در این مطالعه مصنوعی بودند [5]، اما یافته‌ها نشان می‌دهند که دنبال کردن ترک تا آخرین نقطه، بدون عارضه نیست.
claims.source_quote: Standard dentin cracks were induced on the pulpal floor of 40 decoronated, extracted, sound human posterior teeth using a diamond disk, resembling cracks extending from marginal ridges.
claims.note: Two halves, both addressed. Half 1 (the cracks were artificial) matches the quoted Methods sentence. Half 2 (removing the crack completely is not free of complications) also matches: the conclusion states that burs used to remove cracks induced new cracks and extended existing ones, and particle abrasion produced the smallest crack propagation rather than none.

fidelity.source_conclusion: Air particle abrasion induced the fewest new cracks despite removing larger dentin volume.

claims.claim_quote: رستوریشن نهایی دندان ترک‌دارِ علامت‌دار یا درمان ریشه‌شده باید روکش کامل باشد.
claims.source_quote: Full-crown restorations are strongly recommended for the CT with any symptoms and the CT-RCT.
claims.note: instruction judged by F2-iii way 1: the source recommends the action at the same strength (strongly recommended, no hedge). The earlier sentence 'Full-crown restorations are strongly recommended for the CT-RCT.' omits the symptomatic group, so it does not state the claim unchanged (F2-v step 3).

claims.claim_quote: یک متاآنالیز در سال ۲۰۲۴، نتایج درمان را به‌صورت جداگانه برای دندان‌های وایتال و دندان‌های درمان ریشه‌شده بررسی کرده است [6].
claims.source_quote: The aim of this review was to analyze the clinical treatment outcomes of cracked teeth (CT) retaining vital dental pulp (CT-VDP) or undergoing root canal treatment (CT-RCT).
claims.note: The meta-analysis status is also stated in the source (26 studies included in the meta-analysis). The year 2024 is not addressed by the abstract; it is silence, not scored.

claims.claim_quote: در دندان‌های وایتال، ترمیم مستقیم بدون پوشش کاسپی با روکش کامل مقایسه شد.
claims.source_quote: Direct restorations without cuspal coverage for CT-VDP increased the risk ratio (RR) of pulpal complications (RR=3.2, 95 % CI: 1.51-6.82, p = 0.002) and tooth extraction (RR=8.1, 95 % CI: 1.05-62.5, p = 0.045) compared with full-crown restorations.

claims.claim_quote: احتمال بروز مشکلات پالپی در گروه بدون پوشش کاسپی حدود ۳ برابر بیشتر بود [6].
claims.source_quote: Direct restorations without cuspal coverage for CT-VDP increased the risk ratio (RR) of pulpal complications (RR=3.2, 95 % CI: 1.51-6.82, p = 0.002) and tooth extraction (RR=8.1, 95 % CI: 1.05-62.5, p = 0.045) compared with full-crown restorations.
claims.note: «احتمال» here names the measured risk (RR), not an epistemic hedge. The finding is stated in the past tense. «حدود ۳ برابر» restates RR=3.2.

claims.claim_quote: احتمال کشیدن دندان نیز در این گروه بیشتر گزارش شد، هرچند برآورد عددی آن به اندازه‌ی کافی قابل اتکا نبود [6].
claims.source_quote: Direct restorations without cuspal coverage for CT-VDP increased the risk ratio (RR) of pulpal complications (RR=3.2, 95 % CI: 1.51-6.82, p = 0.002) and tooth extraction (RR=8.1, 95 % CI: 1.05-62.5, p = 0.045) compared with full-crown restorations.
claims.note: F3: the higher extraction risk is stated (MATCHES). The second half, that the numeric estimate was not sufficiently reliable, is not stated by the abstract; it reports only the CI. That half is NOT_ASSESSABLE and silent, so it does not decide the verdict.

claims.claim_quote: در دندان‌های درمان ریشه‌شده، اختلاف بیشتر بود.
claims.note: Comparative claim (F2 item 3): the difference in CT-RCT is said to be larger than in vital teeth. No abstract sentence compares the two effect sizes across groups. It reports each separately, so the ranking is silence under ABSTRACT_ONLY.

claims.claim_quote: احتمال کشیدن دندان‌های ترک‌دارِ درمان ریشه‌شده‌ای که روکش کامل نداشتند، حدود ۱۱ برابر بیشتر گزارش شد [6].
claims.source_quote: The CT-RCT without full-crown restorations had an 11.3-fold higher risk of tooth extraction than the CT-RCT with full-crown restorations (p < 0.001).
claims.note: 'about 11-fold' restates 11.3-fold; same direction, population and comparator.

fidelity.source_conclusion: Full-crown restorations are strongly recommended for the CT with any symptoms and the CT-RCT.

claims.source_quote: Combining anatomical measurements and pathologic and histologic knowledge with caries-detecting dye and DIAGNOdent laser fluorescence technologies can produce ideal caries removal end points for adhesive dentistry without exposing vital pulps.
claims.note: pointing word «این اعداد» read through to the caries removal end points built from anatomical measurements; «can» is not a hedge (F2-ii)

claims.claim_quote: مبنای آن‌ها آناتومی دندان است، نه مطالعات بالینی درباره‌ی نتیجه‌ی درمان دندان‌های ترک‌دار [8].

fidelity.source_conclusion: Combining anatomical measurements and pathologic and histologic knowledge with caries-detecting dye and DIAGNOdent laser fluorescence technologies can produce ideal caries removal end points for adhesive dentistry without exposing vital pulps.

claims.source_quote: In conclusion, more rigorous research is needed to validate BRD protocols, focusing on important clinical outcomes that impact in the longevity of the restoration, such as fracture, debonding, post-operative sensitivity, esthetic quality, presence of caries lesions adjacent to restorations and patients' satisfaction need to be thoroughly investigated.
claims.note: The source matches the claim that more rigorous research is needed to validate BRD protocols. The publication year (2024) is not stated in the abstract and is treated as silence (NOT_ASSESSABLE), so it does not affect the verdict. «نیز» is a connective to the rest of the page. The predicate is this source's own finding and is not a relation between sources, so F2 item 4 does not apply.

fidelity.source_conclusion: Reliance on anecdotal evidence, clinical experience, and common sense propagates myths and undervalues the need for a critical approach in evaluating dental techniques.
